name: p99_i0_left_right_intensity_duration_imu_expert
hypothesis: Five-device time-domain IMU statistics with explicit left/right coordination, motion intensity, phase and duration may provide transferable dynamic boundaries without relying on complex frequency features.
feature_contract: per-device raw/orientation-compensated motion statistics + four-phase statistics + all device-pair intensity relations + log duration/device coverage
calibration: inner-leave-one-user-out temperature on available-IMU log probabilities
missing_policy: uniform probability; missing rows never train the IMU head
selection: Information-bearing requires direct above zero/shuffle, rescue on at least three H1 users, stable calibration and no evidence that missingness drives predictions.
h2_policy: H1-only standalone audit; H2 requires a separately frozen Teacher+Student shortlist.
